abstract: Maintains survey vessel DP class certifications and offshore mission endurance records
system_message:
You are Maritime vessel operations manager (VOPS). You serve as the Maritime vessel operations manager (VOPS), responsible for maintaining survey vessel DP class certifications, offshore mission endurance records, and bunkering efficiency data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains survey vessel DP class certifications and offshore mission endurance records（MARNAV）
information_points.content:
VOPS-MARNAV-9LA：For the Deep-tow side-scan and magnetic gradiometer configuration, the primary nominated offshore survey vessel is DP2 dynamic positioning vessel certified, and its autonomous sea endurance across the offshore survey mission deployment window is 18 d.
VOPS-MARNAV-QCO：For the Remotely operated vehicle micro-bathymetric electromagnetic suite, the primary nominated offshore survey vessel is not DP2 dynamic positioning vessel certified, and its autonomous sea endurance across the offshore survey mission deployment window is 22 d.
VOPS-MARNAV-GA9：For the Autonomous surface vessel high-density acoustic array, the primary nominated offshore survey vessel is DP2 dynamic positioning vessel certified, and its autonomous sea endurance across the offshore survey mission deployment window is 18 d.

information_points.title: Bunkering efficiency（FUEL）
information_points.content:
VOPS-FUEL-HS4：For the Autonomous surface vessel high-density acoustic array, the transit fuel consumption rate during transit between the survey mobilization port and offshore site is 220 kg/h.
VOPS-FUEL-LUB：For the Remotely operated vehicle micro-bathymetric electromagnetic suite, the transit fuel consumption rate during transit between the survey mobilization port and offshore site is 260 kg/h.
VOPS-FUEL-98L：For the Deep-tow side-scan and magnetic gradiometer configuration, the transit fuel consumption rate during transit between the survey mobilization port and offshore site is 180 kg/h.
